verdict.rationale: Pomelo hosts an API reference, but it is documented as having only language-tabbed static samples with "zero Probar/Ejecutar/try-it controls", so there are no interactive, runnable examples. No downloadable OpenAPI spec exists to load into an external runner either. The MCP code-example generator and the Stage transaction simulator are separate features, not an interactive reference, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
